## Specific task description

Task instruction: Place the small smooth cup onto the small drink-protecting wooden coaster

Task description: Move the smooth blue small cup on the right side of the table to the round wooden coaster at the front center, then release it.

Success criteria: The cup has been placed on the wooden coaster with little horizontal offset, and its base has been lowered onto the coaster's supporting surface. Both grippers are open.

## Execution tips

- Approach from above the cup opening and select an upper-wall section facing open table space. Put one finger inside and one outside, setting the opening for wall thickness and fingertip clearance to reduce rim collisions.
- Before closing, confirm that the inner finger has passed over the cup rim and both pads can grip the cup wall effectively. Test-lift slightly to check the grasp and avoid hooking only the rim or slipping on the smooth wall.
- Keep the cup opening upward during transfer with clearance beneath its bottom and gripper. Reorient in open space, avoiding upright objects behind the cup and the large bottle at the table center.
- Lower slightly and slowly near the coaster. Release only after the cup base is supported, and withdraw the inner finger upward through the opening where possible, avoiding a drop while suspended or tipping the cup during withdrawal.
